blocks.zh: 前言、導論與術語表
blocks.en: Foreword, Introduction and Glossary

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 了解 PDA 與 IPEC Federation 聯合發布 TR54-6 的背景與動機，以及歐盟法規驅動賦形劑風險評估的歷史脈絡。
blocks.en: Understand the background and motivation for the joint publication of TR54-6 by PDA and the IPEC Federation, and the history of EU regulations driving excipient risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 掌握 TR54-6 的適用範圍：適用於所有人用藥品中使用的賦形劑，並貫穿產品整個生命週期。
blocks.en: Understand the scope of TR54-6: it applies to all excipients used in human medicinal products and throughout the product lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 理解「製造授權持有人 (Manufacturing Authorization Holder, MAH)」在賦形劑風險評估中的核心責任與義務。
blocks.en: Understand the central responsibilities and obligations of the Manufacturing Authorization Holder (MAH) in excipient risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 熟悉 Section 2.0 術語表中的關鍵定義，包含 Broker、Distributor、Repackager、Haulier 等供應鏈角色的法律與操作差異。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the key definitions in the Section 2.0 Glossary, including the legal and operational differences between supply chain roles such as Broker, Distributor, Repackager and Haulier.

blocks.zh: 能夠正確使用縮寫表（Section 2.1），識別 EC、CMO、CQA、GMP、QMS、QRM 等縮寫所對應的全名與監管機構。
blocks.en: Be able to use the abbreviations list (Section 2.1) correctly and identify the full names and regulatory bodies behind EC, CMO, CQA, GMP, QMS, QRM and others.

blocks.zh: Foreword — 前言
blocks.en: Foreword

blocks.zh: 中文解說
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: TR54-6 是什麼？
blocks.en: What is TR54-6?

blocks.zh: PDA Technical Report No. 54-6（2019）是由美國非注射藥品協會（PDA）與國際藥用輔料理事會聯盟（IPEC Federation）共同發布的技術報告。它是 PDA TR54 系列的延伸，專門針對藥品賦形劑 (Excipient) 的品質風險管理 (QRM) 提供實務指引。
blocks.en: PDA Technical Report No. 54-6 (2019) is a technical report jointly published by the Parenteral Drug Association (PDA) and the International Pharmaceutical Excipients Council (IPEC) Federation. It extends the PDA TR54 series and provides practical guidance specifically on quality risk management (QRM) for pharmaceutical excipients.

blocks.zh: 本報告於 2018 年 3 月正式啟動，雙方簽署合作備忘錄（MOU），以「一個聲音」回應製藥業對賦形劑 GMP 評估的迫切需求。
blocks.en: The project was formally launched in March 2018, when the two organizations signed a memorandum of understanding (MOU) to respond "with one voice" to the pharmaceutical industry's urgent need for guidance on assessing excipient GMP.

blocks.zh: IPEC Federation 組成
blocks.en: Composition of the IPEC Federation

blocks.zh: IPEC Federation 由五個地區性賦形劑理事會組成：
blocks.en: The IPEC Federation consists of five regional excipient councils:

blocks.zh: IPEC-Americas（美洲）
blocks.en: IPEC-Americas

blocks.zh: IPEC Europe（歐洲）
blocks.en: IPEC Europe

blocks.zh: IPEC Japan（日本）
blocks.en: IPEC Japan

blocks.zh: IPEC China（中國）
blocks.en: IPEC China

blocks.zh: IPEC India（印度）
blocks.en: IPEC India

blocks.zh: 其目標包含推動國際賦形劑標準調和、引進新型賦形劑，以及建立賦形劑的 GMP 與 GDP 準則。
blocks.en: Its objectives include promoting international harmonization of excipient standards, introducing new excipients, and establishing GMP and GDP guidelines for excipients.

blocks.zh: 法規驅動背景
blocks.en: Regulatory Drivers

blocks.zh: 本報告的發布是為了回應歐盟法規的強制要求：
blocks.en: This report was published in response to mandatory European regulatory requirements:

blocks.zh: EU 假藥指令 (2011/62/EU)：要求製造授權持有人驗證所使用的賦形劑符合適當的 GMP 標準。
blocks.en: EU Falsified Medicines Directive (2011/62/EU): requires manufacturing authorization holders to verify that the excipients they use meet appropriate GMP standards.

blocks.zh: EC Guidelines (2015/C 95/02)：歐盟委員會指引，規定須對賦形劑進行正式化的風險評估。
blocks.en: EC Guidelines (2015/C 95/02): European Commission guidelines that require a formalized risk assessment of excipients.

blocks.zh: PIC/S 2018：將相同規定納入全球適用的發布文件，擴大了適用範圍。
blocks.en: PIC/S 2018: incorporates the same requirement into a globally applicable publication, broadening its reach.

blocks.zh: TR54-6 正是回應上述法規需求，協助業界以系統化方式落實賦形劑風險評估。
blocks.en: TR54-6 responds directly to these regulatory requirements and helps industry implement excipient risk assessment in a systematic way.

blocks.zh: 比喻：餐廳食材採購
blocks.en: Analogy: Sourcing Restaurant Ingredients

blocks.zh: 賦形劑風險評估就像高檔餐廳的食材管理。您需要知道：
blocks.en: Excipient risk assessment is like ingredient management at a fine-dining restaurant. You need to know:

blocks.zh: 食材來源（賦形劑原始製造商是誰？）
blocks.en: Where the ingredients come from (who is the original manufacturer of the excipient?)

blocks.zh: 誰經手過食材（供應鏈中有哪些中間商？）
blocks.en: Who has handled them (which intermediaries are in the supply chain?)

blocks.zh: 是否符合食安標準（賦形劑的 GMP 水平是否符合藥品品質要求？）
blocks.en: Whether they meet food safety standards (does the excipient's GMP level meet the quality requirements for medicinal products?)

blocks.zh: 同樣地，製造授權持有人有責任確保每種賦形劑從製造端到使用端，全程符合適當的品質標準，以保障病患安全。
blocks.en: In the same way, the manufacturing authorization holder is responsible for ensuring that every excipient meets appropriate quality standards from manufacture through to use, in order to protect patient safety.

blocks.zh: Section 1.0 Introduction — 導論
blocks.en: Section 1.0 Introduction

blocks.zh: 核心概念：賦形劑 (Excipient)
blocks.en: Key Concept: Excipient

blocks.zh: 賦形劑是藥品中除活性藥物成分（API）與包裝材料以外的所有成分。依據不同定義來源：
blocks.en: An excipient is any component of a medicinal product other than the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API) and the packaging material. Depending on the source of the definition:

blocks.zh: EC 定義：藥品中除活性成分及包裝材料以外的任何成分。
blocks.en: EC definition: any constituent of a medicinal product other than the active substance and the packaging material.

blocks.zh: IPEC 定義：非 API、已進行適當安全性評估、並有意納入藥物傳遞系統的物質。
blocks.en: IPEC definition: a substance, other than the API, that has been appropriately evaluated for safety and is intentionally included in a drug delivery system.

blocks.zh: 賦形劑的功能包含：協助配方成型、充當功能性或非功能性成分、控制藥物釋放，以及在儲存期間維持藥品的安全性與功能性。
blocks.en: Excipient functions include aiding formulation, acting as a functional or non-functional component, controlling drug release, and maintaining the safety and functionality of the medicinal product during storage.

blocks.zh: 核心概念：製造授權持有人 (Manufacturing Authorization Holder, MAH)
blocks.en: Key Concept: Manufacturing Authorization Holder (MAH)

blocks.zh: MAH 是持有製造授權、負責藥品生產的法人實體。在 TR54-6 的框架下，MAH 承擔賦形劑風險評估的全部責任，包括：
blocks.en: The MAH is the legal entity that holds the manufacturing authorization and is responsible for producing the medicinal product. Under the TR54-6 framework, the MAH bears full responsibility for excipient risk assessment, including:

blocks.zh: 主動評估每種賦形劑對產品品質、安全性與純度的風險。
blocks.en: Proactively assessing the risk each excipient poses to product quality, safety and purity.

blocks.zh: 向賦形劑供應商溝通所需的品質標準。
blocks.en: Communicating the required quality standards to excipient suppliers.

blocks.zh: 處理評估發現的任何 GMP 缺口。
blocks.en: Addressing any GMP gaps identified in the assessment.

blocks.zh: 定期複審風險評估的有效性。
blocks.en: Periodically reviewing the effectiveness of the risk assessment.

blocks.zh: 雖然供應鏈各方需配合提供資訊，但最終責任仍在 MAH 身上，不可轉嫁。
blocks.en: Although the parties in the supply chain must cooperate by providing information, final responsibility remains with the MAH and cannot be transferred.

blocks.zh: 重要提示：TR54-6 不取代法規要求
blocks.en: Important Note: TR54-6 Does Not Replace Regulatory Requirements

blocks.zh: TR54-6 的目的在於提供實務指引框架，協助 MAH 落實賦形劑風險評估。它：
blocks.en: The purpose of TR54-6 is to provide a practical guidance framework to help the MAH implement excipient risk assessment. It:

blocks.zh: 不取代或修改現有的法定及法規要求。
blocks.en: Does not replace or modify existing statutory and regulatory requirements.

blocks.zh: 與 EC Guidelines、PIC/S 出版物及 ICH Q9 QRM 原則相輔相成。
blocks.en: Complements the EC Guidelines, PIC/S publications and the ICH Q9 QRM principles.

blocks.zh: 提供模型風險評估與實際案例，作為實務參考。
blocks.en: Provides a model risk assessment and practical examples for reference.

blocks.zh: 換句話說，TR54-6 是業界的最佳實務工具書，幫助企業達到法規要求，但法規本身（EC Guidelines 等）才是法律義務的來源。
blocks.en: In other words, TR54-6 is an industry best-practice handbook that helps companies meet regulatory requirements, but the regulations themselves (the EC Guidelines, etc.) are the source of legal obligations.

blocks.zh: 賦形劑風險評估的驅動因素
blocks.en: Triggers for Excipient Risk Assessment

blocks.zh: 以下情況需啟動或重新進行賦形劑風險評估：
blocks.en: An excipient risk assessment should be initiated or repeated in the following situations:

blocks.zh: 產品偏差 (product deviations)
blocks.en: Product deviations

blocks.zh: 市場召回 (market recalls)
blocks.en: Market recalls

blocks.zh: 賦形劑用途變更 (changes in excipient use)
blocks.en: Changes in excipient use

blocks.zh: 供應鏈修改 (supply chain amendments)
blocks.en: Supply chain amendments

blocks.zh: 品質不良趨勢 (adverse trends in quality)
blocks.en: Adverse trends in quality

blocks.zh: 風險管理流程貫穿賦形劑的整個生命週期——從最初的選擇，直到停止使用為止。
blocks.en: The risk management process runs throughout the excipient lifecycle, from initial selection until the excipient is no longer used.

blocks.zh: Figure 1.0-1 解讀：賦形劑適用性判定流程
blocks.en: Interpreting Figure 1.0-1: Excipient Suitability Decision Process

blocks.zh: 圖 1.0-1 展示的是一個迭代式的風險管理循環，核心問題是「該賦形劑是否適合用於此藥品？」流程分為三個核心階段：
blocks.en: Figure 1.0-1 shows an iterative risk management cycle built around the core question, "Is this excipient suitable for use in this medicinal product?" The process has three main stages:

blocks.zh: 風險識別：整合 QMS、製造與供應鏈資訊，結合給藥途徑與賦形劑功能，建立評估基礎。
blocks.en: Risk identification: integrates QMS, manufacturing and supply chain information with the route of administration and excipient function to establish the basis for the assessment.

blocks.zh: 風險評估：分為賦形劑供應商評估（外部）與內部文件評估兩個維度，產出低/中/高風險評分。
blocks.en: Risk assessment: has two dimensions, the excipient supplier assessment (external) and the internal documentation assessment, and produces a low/medium/high risk score.

blocks.zh: 控制與複審：視風險評分決定接受風險或實施風險降低措施，並透過持續監測（KPI、事件、稽核）維持動態管理。
blocks.en: Control and review: depending on the risk score, the risk is either accepted or risk reduction measures are implemented, and ongoing monitoring (KPIs, events, audits) keeps the process under dynamic management.

blocks.zh: Section 1.1 Purpose — 目的
blocks.en: Section 1.1 Purpose

blocks.zh: TR54-6 的目的（Purpose）
blocks.en: Purpose of TR54-6

blocks.zh: TR54-6 建立於品質風險管理 (QRM) 的一般原則之上，具體依據為 ICH Q9。其核心目的為：
blocks.en: TR54-6 is built on the general principles of quality risk management (QRM), specifically ICH Q9. Its core purposes are to:

blocks.zh: 提供 EC Guidelines 要求的賦形劑風險評估流程之額外指引。
blocks.en: Provide additional guidance on the excipient risk assessment process required by the EC Guidelines.

blocks.zh: 呈現一個模型風險評估（model risk assessment），適用於所有劑型。
blocks.en: Present a model risk assessment that is applicable to all dosage forms.

blocks.zh: 透過真實案例（Annex I, Sections 10.1–10.6），示範如何將風險評估作為知識管理的工具。
blocks.en: Demonstrate, through real-world examples (Annex I, Sections 10.1-10.6), how risk assessment can be used as a knowledge management tool.

blocks.zh: 採用 ICH Q9 的風險排序與篩選法（risk ranking and filtering method）作為評估基礎。
blocks.en: Use the ICH Q9 risk ranking and filtering method as the basis for the assessment.

blocks.zh: 兩大實務挑戰
blocks.en: Two Practical Challenges

blocks.zh: 挑戰一：品質系統多元性
blocks.en: Challenge 1: Diversity of quality systems

blocks.zh: 許多賦形劑並非專門為藥品用途製造，而是用於食品、化妝品或家用品等行業。這些製造商的品質系統設計並非以藥品 GMP 為首要考量，導致 MAH 要求其升級至藥品品質系統時面臨阻礙。
blocks.en: Many excipients are not made specifically for pharmaceutical use but for industries such as food, cosmetics or household products. These manufacturers' quality systems are not designed with pharmaceutical GMP as the first priority, which makes it difficult for the MAH to ask them to upgrade to a pharmaceutical quality system.

blocks.zh: 挑戰二：多劑型導致 GMP 要求衝突
blocks.en: Challenge 2: Conflicting GMP requirements from multiple dosage forms

blocks.zh: 同一種賦形劑可能同時被用於錠劑與注射劑。注射劑（非腸道製劑）的 GMP 要求遠高於口服固體劑型，但兩者可能都採購自同一個供應商，因此 MAH 內部可能對同一賦形劑產生相互矛盾的 GMP 要求，需要謹慎管理。
blocks.en: The same excipient may be used in both tablets and injectables. GMP requirements for injectables (parenteral products) are far higher than for oral solid dosage forms, yet both may be purchased from the same supplier. The MAH may therefore hold conflicting internal GMP requirements for the same excipient, which must be managed carefully.

blocks.zh: 比喻：食品廠轉型醫材供應商
blocks.en: Analogy: A Food Plant Becoming a Pharmaceutical Supplier

blocks.zh: 想像一家工廠主要生產食用澱粉（食品 GMP），但藥廠想要採購其澱粉作為片劑賦形劑。食品 GMP 與藥品 GMP 的要求有顯著差距——這正是 TR54-6 所說的「品質系統多元性挑戰」。MAH 必須透過風險評估，判斷此供應商的現有品質水平是否足夠，或需要要求其改進。
blocks.en: Imagine a plant that mainly produces edible starch (under food GMP), and a pharmaceutical company wants to buy that starch as a tablet excipient. Food GMP and pharmaceutical GMP differ significantly, and this is exactly the "diversity of quality systems" challenge described in TR54-6. Through risk assessment, the MAH must judge whether the supplier's existing quality level is sufficient or whether improvements need to be requested.

blocks.zh: Section 1.2 Scope — 適用範圍
blocks.en: Section 1.2 Scope

blocks.zh: 適用範圍解析
blocks.en: Understanding the Scope

blocks.zh: TR54-6 的範圍具有以下特點：
blocks.en: The scope of TR54-6 has the following characteristics:

blocks.zh: 適用對象：所有用於人用藥品的賦形劑（不含獸藥）。
blocks.en: Who it applies to: all excipients used in human medicinal products (veterinary medicines are not included).

blocks.zh: 生命週期：涵蓋產品生命週期的所有階段。
blocks.en: Lifecycle: covers all stages of the product lifecycle.

blocks.zh: 主要假設：預設為商業化供應階段（commercial supply phase）使用。
blocks.en: Main assumption: use in the commercial supply phase is assumed by default.

blocks.zh: 臨床階段：MAH 可選擇性地在臨床試驗階段應用，但 TR54-6 不規定應從哪個臨床試驗階段開始。
blocks.en: Clinical phase: the MAH may optionally apply it during clinical trials, but TR54-6 does not specify from which clinical trial phase it should start.

blocks.zh: 範圍的實務意涵
blocks.en: Practical Implications of the Scope

blocks.zh: 「所有賦形劑」意味著不論賦形劑是否具有複雜的藥理功能，只要被納入藥品配方，MAH 就必須對其進行風險評估。這包括常見的如微晶纖維素（MCC）、乳糖，以及較複雜的如具有緩釋功能的聚合物賦形劑。
blocks.en: "All excipients" means that, regardless of whether an excipient has a complex pharmacological function, the MAH must perform a risk assessment on it as long as it is included in the product formulation. This covers common excipients such as microcrystalline cellulose (MCC) and lactose, as well as more complex ones such as polymeric excipients with a controlled-release function.

blocks.zh: TR54-6 不對動物用藥品（獸藥）提供直接指引，但其原則可以類比應用。
blocks.en: TR54-6 does not provide direct guidance for veterinary medicinal products, but its principles can be applied by analogy.

blocks.zh: Section 2.0 Glossary and Abbreviations — 術語表與縮寫表
blocks.en: Section 2.0 Glossary and Abbreviations

blocks.zh: 為何精確定義術語如此重要？
blocks.en: Why Precise Definitions Matter

blocks.zh: 在 GMP 環境中，術語的精確性直接影響責任歸屬與法律義務。以賦形劑供應鏈為例，以下四個角色的定義截然不同，其所承擔的 GMP 責任也相差甚遠：
blocks.en: In a GMP environment, the precision of terminology directly affects the allocation of responsibility and legal obligations. In the excipient supply chain, for example, the following four roles are defined very differently and carry very different GMP responsibilities:

blocks.zh: 原始製造商 (Original Manufacturer)：將材料製造至可被指定為賦形劑階段的主體，GMP 責任最高。
blocks.en: Original Manufacturer: the entity that manufactures the material up to the stage at which it can be designated as an excipient; carries the highest GMP responsibility.

blocks.zh: 經銷商 (Distributor)：取得賦形劑法律所有權，負責分銷，需符合 GDP 要求。
blocks.en: Distributor: takes legal ownership of the excipient and is responsible for distribution; must comply with GDP requirements.

blocks.zh: 再包裝商 (Repackager)：將賦形劑重新包裝，可能改變標籤，引入額外的品質風險。
blocks.en: Repackager: repackages the excipient and may change the labeling, introducing additional quality risk.

blocks.zh: 仲介商 (Broker)：純粹的中間人，不進行實體處理（無倉儲、運輸、再包裝），僅促成買賣。
blocks.en: Broker: a pure intermediary that does no physical handling (no storage, transport or repackaging) and merely facilitates the sale and purchase.

blocks.zh: 正確區分這些角色，才能正確評估供應鏈風險等級。
blocks.en: Only by distinguishing these roles correctly can the risk level of the supply chain be assessed correctly.

blocks.zh: 縮寫表解析：監管機構對應
blocks.en: Understanding the Abbreviations: Mapping to Regulatory Bodies

blocks.zh: Section 2.1 的縮寫表雖然簡短，但每個縮寫都指向重要的監管或技術概念：
blocks.en: The abbreviations list in Section 2.1 is short, but each abbreviation points to an important regulatory or technical concept:

blocks.zh: EC（European Commission）：歐盟委員會，發布 EC Guidelines (2015/C 95/02)，是本報告的主要法規依據之一。
blocks.en: EC (European Commission): the body that issued the EC Guidelines (2015/C 95/02), one of the main regulatory bases for this report.

blocks.zh: CMO（Contract Manufacturing Organization）：委託製造機構，在複雜供應鏈中扮演重要角色（詳見 Section 4.1.6）。
blocks.en: CMO (Contract Manufacturing Organization): plays an important role in complex supply chains (see Section 4.1.6).

blocks.zh: CQA（Critical Quality Attributes）：關鍵品質屬性，是賦形劑適用性評估的核心指標，來源定義為 ICH Q8 R2。
blocks.en: CQA (Critical Quality Attributes): the core measure in assessing excipient suitability; the source definition is ICH Q8 (R2).

blocks.zh: GMP（Good Manufacturing Practices）：良好製造規範，是整份 TR54-6 的核心議題。
blocks.en: GMP (Good Manufacturing Practices): the central subject of the entire TR54-6.

blocks.zh: QMS（Quality Management System）：品質管理系統，供應商評估時需審查其 QMS 的成熟度。
blocks.en: QMS (Quality Management System): the maturity of a supplier's QMS needs to be reviewed during supplier assessment.

blocks.zh: QRM（Quality Risk Management）：品質風險管理，TR54-6 的整體方法論框架，依據 ICH Q9。
blocks.en: QRM (Quality Risk Management): the overall methodological framework of TR54-6, based on ICH Q9.

blocks.zh: EXCiPACT 認證的意義
blocks.en: What EXCiPACT Certification Means

blocks.zh: EXCiPACT 是全球第一個針對藥品賦形劑製造商與經銷商的國際認證計畫。取得 EXCiPACT 認證的供應商，代表其已通過獨立第三方稽核，符合製藥級 GMP/GDP 要求。
blocks.en: EXCiPACT is the world's first international certification scheme for pharmaceutical excipient manufacturers and distributors. A supplier holding EXCiPACT certification has passed an independent third-party audit and meets pharmaceutical-grade GMP/GDP requirements.

blocks.zh: 在 TR54-6 的風險評估框架中，供應商是否持有 EXCiPACT 認證是評估其品質水平的重要考量指標，通常有助於降低風險評分。
blocks.en: In the TR54-6 risk assessment framework, whether a supplier holds EXCiPACT certification is an important indicator of its quality level and generally helps lower the risk score.

blocks.zh: QTPP 與 CQA 的關係
blocks.en: The Relationship between QTPP and CQAs

blocks.zh: 品質目標產品概況 (QTPP) 是對藥品理想品質特性的前瞻性總結，定義了「最終藥品應達到什麼樣的品質標準」。從 QTPP 衍生出各個關鍵品質屬性 (CQA)，這些 CQA 反映了哪些特性對藥品安全性與療效至關重要。
blocks.en: The Quality Target Product Profile (QTPP) is a prospective summary of the quality characteristics of the ideal medicinal product and defines "what quality standard the final product should meet." The critical quality attributes (CQAs) are derived from the QTPP and reflect which characteristics are essential to the safety and efficacy of the product.

blocks.zh: 在賦形劑風險評估中，CQA 幫助 MAH 判斷某種賦形劑對藥品 CQA 的影響程度，進而決定其風險等級。例如：用於注射劑的賦形劑若影響產品的滲透壓（CQA），其風險等級將高於僅作為填充劑的口服賦形劑。
blocks.en: In excipient risk assessment, CQAs help the MAH judge how strongly an excipient affects the CQAs of the medicinal product, and thereby determine its risk level. For example, an excipient used in an injectable that affects the product's osmolality (a CQA) carries a higher risk level than an excipient used only as a filler in an oral product.

blocks.zh: 理解確認：思考題
blocks.en: Check Your Understanding: Discussion Questions

blocks.zh: 根據 TR54-6 的術語定義，一家將賦形劑從A廠移至B廠的物流公司，應被歸類為哪種供應鏈角色（Haulier、Distributor、Broker 或 Repackager）？這個分類對風險評估有何影響？
blocks.en: Under the TR54-6 glossary definitions, which supply chain role (Haulier, Distributor, Broker or Repackager) should a logistics company that moves an excipient from Site A to Site B be classified as? How does this classification affect the risk assessment?

blocks.zh: 若一名 Broker 從未接觸賦形劑實體，為什麼 TR54-6 中仍將其視為供應鏈風險來源之一？（提示：思考資訊透明度與可追溯性）
blocks.en: If a Broker never physically handles the excipient, why does TR54-6 still treat the Broker as a source of supply chain risk? (Hint: think about information transparency and traceability.)

blocks.zh: TR54-6 說「風險評估的責任完全在 Manufacturing Authorization Holder 身上」——這是否意味著供應商完全不需要負責？請結合 Section 1.0 的內容說明供應鏈各方的角色。
blocks.en: TR54-6 states that "responsibility for the risk assessment lies entirely with the Manufacturing Authorization Holder." Does this mean the supplier has no responsibility at all? Explain the roles of the parties in the supply chain with reference to Section 1.0.

blocks.zh: 實務應用：CDMO 情境分析
blocks.en: Practical Application: CDMO Scenario Analysis

blocks.zh: CDMO 情境：TR54-6 的實務要求
blocks.en: CDMO Scenario: Practical Requirements of TR54-6

blocks.zh: 當一家委託開發暨製造機構（CDMO）同時為多個客戶製造不同劑型的藥品，並從全球多個供應商採購賦形劑時，TR54-6 要求 CDMO 考量以下關鍵因素：
blocks.en: When a contract development and manufacturing organization (CDMO) manufactures medicinal products in different dosage forms for multiple clients and purchases excipients from many suppliers worldwide, TR54-6 requires the CDMO to consider the following key factors:

blocks.zh: 1. 按劑型分別評估風險
blocks.en: 1. Assess risk separately by dosage form

blocks.zh: 同一種 HPMC 賦形劑，用於口服錠劑（低風險）與注射劑（高風險）時，其 CQA 要求截然不同。CDMO 必須針對每種給藥途徑進行獨立評估，不可一概而論。
blocks.en: The same HPMC excipient has very different CQA requirements when used in an oral tablet (low risk) and in an injectable (high risk). The CDMO must perform an independent assessment for each route of administration and must not generalize.

blocks.zh: 2. 按供應鏈結構評估風險
blocks.en: 2. Assess risk by supply chain structure

blocks.zh: 供應商 A（直接供貨）：供應鏈最短，可追溯性最高，風險最低。
blocks.en: Supplier A (direct supply): shortest supply chain, highest traceability, lowest risk.

blocks.zh: 供應商 B（經銷商＋再包裝）：再包裝引入污染風險與標示錯誤風險，需稽核再包裝商的 GMP 控制措施。
blocks.en: Supplier B (distributor plus repackager): repackaging introduces contamination and labeling error risks, so the repackager's GMP controls need to be audited.

blocks.zh: 供應商 C（仲介商、原始製造商不明）：資訊最不透明，可追溯性最差，風險最高——依 TR54-6，此情況下 CDMO 應特別審慎，可能需要要求 Broker 揭露原始製造商資訊。
blocks.en: Supplier C (broker, original manufacturer unknown): the least transparent, with the poorest traceability and the highest risk. Under TR54-6, the CDMO should be especially cautious in this case and may need to require the Broker to disclose the original manufacturer.

blocks.zh: 3. MAH 責任的特殊性
blocks.en: 3. The particular position of the MAH's responsibility

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 情境中，法律上的 Manufacturing Authorization Holder 通常是委託方（創新藥廠），而非 CDMO 本身。但 CDMO 仍需配合提供相關資訊（如賦形劑資訊套件），並確保其供應鏈符合客戶 MAH 的品質協議要求。
blocks.en: In a CDMO scenario, the legal Manufacturing Authorization Holder is usually the sponsor (the innovator pharmaceutical company), not the CDMO itself. The CDMO must still cooperate by providing the relevant information (such as the excipient information package) and ensure that its supply chain meets the requirements of the client MAH's quality agreement.

blocks.zh: 4. 全球風險評估的統一性
blocks.en: 4. Consistency of the global risk assessment

blocks.zh: TR54-6 建議採用全球統一的風險評估方法，以「最壞案例」（worst case）評分代表所有劑型，向賦形劑製造商傳遞一致的品質要求，避免企業內部不同部門對同一供應商提出相互矛盾的要求。
blocks.en: TR54-6 recommends a globally consistent risk assessment approach, using the "worst case" score to represent all dosage forms, so that consistent quality requirements are communicated to the excipient manufacturer and different departments within a company do not place conflicting requirements on the same supplier.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧
blocks.en: Key Takeaways

blocks.zh: 法規背景：TR54-6 由 PDA 與 IPEC Federation 聯合發布，主要回應 EU 假藥指令（2011/62/EU）及 EC Guidelines (2015/C 95/02) 的法規要求，協助 MAH 建立正式化的賦形劑風險評估制度。
blocks.en: Regulatory background: TR54-6 is jointly published by PDA and the IPEC Federation, mainly in response to the requirements of the EU Falsified Medicines Directive (2011/62/EU) and the EC Guidelines (2015/C 95/02), and helps the MAH establish a formalized excipient risk assessment system.

blocks.zh: 核心責任：賦形劑風險評估的責任完全歸屬於製造授權持有人（MAH）；供應鏈各方需提供資訊支援，但不可替代 MAH 的責任。
blocks.en: Core responsibility: responsibility for excipient risk assessment rests entirely with the manufacturing authorization holder (MAH); parties in the supply chain must provide supporting information but cannot take over the MAH's responsibility.

blocks.zh: 適用範圍：適用於所有人用藥品中使用的賦形劑，涵蓋產品整個生命週期，以商業化階段為主，MAH 亦可選擇性適用於臨床試驗階段。
blocks.en: Scope: applies to all excipients used in human medicinal products and covers the entire product lifecycle, mainly the commercial phase; the MAH may also optionally apply it to the clinical trial phase.

blocks.zh: 術語精確性：Broker、Distributor、Repackager 與 Haulier 在 TR54-6 中有明確的法律定義，代表不同的供應鏈角色與風險等級——混淆這些角色將導致錯誤的風險評估結果。
blocks.en: Terminology precision: Broker, Distributor, Repackager and Haulier have clear legal definitions in TR54-6 and represent different supply chain roles and risk levels; confusing these roles leads to incorrect risk assessment results.

blocks.zh: TR54-6 的定位：本技術報告是實務指引框架，與 EC Guidelines、ICH Q9 及現行法規相輔相成，但不取代任何現行法定或法規要求。
blocks.en: Positioning of TR54-6: this technical report is a practical guidance framework that complements the EC Guidelines, ICH Q9 and current regulations, but does not replace any existing statutory or regulatory requirement.
